description: Clover 2 is Kitani's MoLE (Mixture of LoRA Experts) model: a base model with seven LoRA experts and trained per-token routing between them. Text chat with reasoning off by default (Clover 2 Thinking turns it on). It supports function calling and a 200,000-token context window shared by input and output, with up to 8,192 output tokens.
name: Clover 2
